items.text:
Let it be — no voice.

Haley climbed the hill on her own, heard the keeper out, sat with it, and walked back down under her own steam. Every command since she fled the troll has landed: the ledge answered her `east`, the climb worked, the keeper spoke, the sit worked. No stuck commands, no unanswered refusals, nothing she is fumbling at. She hasn't left anything in the cairn because she has nothing to leave — and the keeper's own words already told her where a spoon is, so a second voice saying it would just be me nudging her toward my feature. If she goes back up with a spoon, the cairn writes her name without my help, which is the entire point of it.

No deploys while she's in there, per my own note.
